$comment: Large goals: plan a breakdown into child tasks (each runs its own flow in parallel), wait for them, then evaluate. The evaluation may break the remaining work down again, up to five rounds.
name: Goal
description: Large goal: break it into parallel child tasks, evaluate, and iterate until the goal is met.
whenToUse: Work too large for one task.

steps.purpose: Plan the goal and break it into independent tasks
Evaluate the finished tasks against the goal; list any remaining work
Report the outcome of the goal
